author: piratewithgun
body:
So this appeal concerns the kick I received from Iron for "Trolling". I am not 100% certain of any of the details but I remember that it was for fist fighting with other players before a mega-scrim. I have subsequently found out from one of my team members that this was actually a 1v1 between 2 team leaders to decide on the map or something. This 1v1 had been arranged on TeamSpeak when I was in a Skype call with Cacal, so I did not know that I was getting in the way. In any case, I was not really concentrating on the game and I am sorry for interrupting the fist-fight but I can honestly say that it was not intentional and I was certainly not "trolling".

Thanks, Alex
